video_title: NBA champions New York Knicks live on GMA

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the emotional weight of winning the NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: It was honestly a lifetime. I knew I had to because that face was probably going to look crazy.
quotes.quote: It was honestly a lifetime. I knew I had to because that face was probably going to look crazy on TV. But I think the best part about it is knowing that these guys have my back night in and night out, and so made that moment ten times more special.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on Tom Thibodeau's ability to adjust the team's game plan
quotes.excerpt: I think after Game 3, his ability to adjust our team offensively and defensively speaks volumes.
quotes.quote: I think after Game 3, his ability to adjust our team offensively and defensively speaks volumes to him as a coach, working on the fly and also just hearing his players out. He always talks about us being a veteran group, trusting our experience and trusting our mindsets and our intellectual capital.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the significance of winning with his father, Rick Brunson
quotes.excerpt: Him being a journeyman in the NBA, I never really got to be around him consistently.
quotes.quote: Him being a journeyman in the NBA, I never really got to be around him consistently. Over these last four years, it's been the most consistent I've been able to be around my dad, so it made the moment ten times more special.

quotes.speaker: OG Anunoby
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby on his game-winning shot in Game 4
quotes.excerpt: I mean, kind of, just because we won, because in the moment, you know, had to get ready.
quotes.quote: I mean, kind of, just because we won, because in the moment, you know, had to get ready for Game 5, so couldn't really dwell on it or be excited about it. Just had to prepare and, you know, watch the film and just erase that game and move on.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the influence of his mother on his career
quotes.excerpt: To be raised by a strong woman is such an honor, and to understand the value of women.
quotes.quote: To be raised by a strong woman is such an honor, and to understand the value of women in my life and in the world comes from her. To be able to have this opportunity to talk to you, to play the game of basketball I love so much, to be a son, all because of her. So, obviously, her impact in my life can't be outmatched.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on Jordan's impact and the Knicks' playoff run
quotes.excerpt: That bag is undoubtedly probably one of the greatest articles of clothing that New York has ever seen.
quotes.quote: That bag is undoubtedly probably one of the greatest articles of clothing that New York has ever seen. It's had a run for sure, undefeated in the playoffs. New York has a lot to thank her for.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the healing power of the Knicks' championship
quotes.excerpt: I feel like for just not only the alumni, but the fans, this was healing.
quotes.quote: I feel like for just not only the alumni, but the fans, this was healing, happening in real life, in real time. Knicks fans have been asking for this moment for 27 years since 1999, and to finally get back to this point where you see the Larry O'Brien on the court, you see a Knicks jersey having a Finals patch, and to also see the Knicks win, it's something special.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on the surreal experience of reuniting with teammates from Villanova
quotes.excerpt: It's just crazy how we all, you know, being on the same team again, it's just crazy.
quotes.quote: It's just crazy how we all, you know, being on the same team again, it's just crazy, you know, even talking about this now and being here today. We're very grateful, you know, to win a championship in college, but to be on the same team and, you know, win a championship for the city, being together is just it's just an amazing feeling.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on the natural chemistry of playing with former college teammates
quotes.excerpt: I think it's just second nature. It's like everybody always asks like, you know, what's the chemistry like.
quotes.quote: I think it's just second nature. It's like everybody always asks like, you know, what's the chemistry like. I think it's just, you know, this is two guys on a starting lineup that I don't have to think, you know, playing when we out there. It's just so second nature being out there so many times in college, so many reps, so many practices, so it just makes it a little bit easier when you got two guys out there you just know how they going to play and you know how to read and react off each other.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on sharing the post-game press conference with his sons
quotes.excerpt: As the dad, that's what you you wish for, moments like that.
quotes.quote: As the dad, that's what you you wish for, moments like that. Those are the moments and memories that I'm going to have for a lifetime. I think one of my favorite photos is Jalen giving Hendrix his little MVP trophy and Hendrix is sitting there holding that with a hat that's too big for him.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on his love for New York City's dining scene
quotes.excerpt: That'll be amazing because I like to eat good. I like to have good wine.
quotes.quote: That'll be amazing because I like to eat good. I like to have good wine. I went to Terrazza last night, it has an amazing Italian food, has some great wine, so yeah, I'm going to cash in for sure.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the significance of the upcoming championship parade
quotes.excerpt: Seeing yourself in those historical photos and actually knowing you're actually in those photos.
quotes.quote: Seeing yourself in those historical photos and actually knowing you're actually in those photos. You see so many times, you like you said, you're seeing the greats, you know, have this parade and to see great New York teams have that moment and for it to finally be our time, you know, it's one of those things you always dream of as a kid, especially growing up in the area.
